description: The keys an app has, without their secrets: an `api` or `mobile` project's client keys, or keys a server uses to call a private website. Use it to show the person which keys exist, when each was last used, and which to revoke. Read-only.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: api_keys
title: API keys
